author: Codex SMG workstream, agent c39c4577-4fa7-4fdf-9123-db3e81a3c554
referenceUse: Viewed by author, style described in prompts; not supplied as a tool edit target.
scope: Original fictional visual game props; raster concepts only, no Blender or production provenance claimed.

initialPrompts.title: A — SWITCHBACK
initialPrompts.detail: A distinctive forked silhouette: short wide flattened rectangular receiver with coral top slab, two thick separated charcoal stock rails ending in a broad shoulder pad, deliberately large open U-shaped negative space behind the body readable from overhead. Short blunt centered muzzle, cyan front collar, compact rear pistol grip, short simple curved box magazine below belly; forward underside support-hand region. Stock gap is the major identity; keep wide fork visible from directly overhead. Petrol painted body, coral top plane, charcoal grips; cyan is a small accent, not glowing all over.
initialPrompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original SMG visual concept sheet for an irreverent top-down city game. Smooth stylized 3D, chunky rounded bevels, simple large material regions. Accepted mood: ordinary urban architecture lit dark vibrant cyan, coral and magenta cyberpunk light; game objects remain readable. Fictional design, not based on a real manufacturer, no logos or brands. Entire sheet depicts ONE consistent original submachine-gun game prop, NOT engineering, mechanism, manufacturing instructions or a cutaway. Compact two-hand weapon visibly between a little pistol and a long cylindrical rocket launcher. Metres provisional, humanoid near 1.8m, overall weapon length approximately 0.8m; modest exaggerated width for top-down read, no scope/optic obscuring roof silhouette.
Layout: clean landscape concept board on dark petrol background, generous margins. Large three-quarter view across upper left, clean true overhead view upper right (muzzle pointing towards top of page), clean side profile lower left, lower right two-hand shoulder-level aiming pose drawn with neutral faceless grey mannequin and no character costume. Show a separate small black overhead silhouette next to large overhead view. Include a tiny overhead weapon study intentionally simplified at roughly 20 pixels long, presented within a spacious unzoomed patch, as illustrative game-scale recognition only. Match shape and colors in every view. Neutral key light with restrained cyan/coral rim light, clear midtone surfaces; no muzzle flash, no projectiles, no effects, no collision, no ornament scene. White concise labels only: title, 'OVERHEAD', 'SIDE', 'TWO-HAND POSE', 'ILLUSTRATIVE SCALE'. Grip must be visually clear, support hand under front body, barrel/muzzle unobscured, stock connects to shoulder; pose anatomy plausible. No decorative micro-greebles. Prioritize roof silhouette and broad contrasts.
Text (verbatim): 'A — SWITCHBACK'.
Design direction: A distinctive forked silhouette: short wide flattened rectangular receiver with coral top slab, two thick separated charcoal stock rails ending in a broad shoulder pad, deliberately large open U-shaped negative space behind the body readable from overhead. Short blunt centered muzzle, cyan front collar, compact rear pistol grip, short simple curved box magazine below belly; forward underside support-hand region. Stock gap is the major identity; keep wide fork visible from directly overhead. Petrol painted body, coral top plane, charcoal grips; cyan is a small accent, not glowing all over.

initialPrompts.title: B — ROUNDABOUT
initialPrompts.detail: Rounded eccentric urban prop: stout oval drum belly bulges symmetrically left and right of a short rectangular body, making a broad rounded clover/paddle outline in overhead view. Drum is clearly attached below receiver but sides project beyond it and remain visible from above. Small stub barrel with coral muzzle collar, short solid shoulder stock with charcoal shoulder pad, rear pistol grip and front underside support grip clear of drum. Dark petrol receiver, broad warm coral drum sides/top edges, muted cyan rectangular roof inset. Smooth chunky design with three primary masses; intentionally a compact SMG, not a grenade launcher, large cannon or circular saw. No blade or spikes.

initialPrompts.title: C — WEDGEWIRE
initialPrompts.detail: Flat angular wedge silhouette: compact wide beveled trapezoidal body tapering sharply to a very short centered muzzle, one bold broad cyan diagonal stripe across a coral upper shell. Rear body has a single offset-looking broad solid charcoal shoulder stock joined centrally so grip and firing direction still centered. Short charcoal pistol grip below rear, simple straight box magazine beneath middle, support hand under tapered forward shell. Roof plan is a crisp chevron/arrowhead with shoulders wider than muzzle, visibly different from fork-stock and drum-body designs. No scope, no tube, no transparent parts, not a raygun; an exaggerated original two-hand SMG prop.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create a polished original game-art concept sheet of ONE fictional toy-like compact two-hand SMG prop for a humorous stylized cyberpunk videogame. Smooth simplified 3D plastic-like forms, big rounded bevels, broad petrol/coral/cyan color blocks, few parts and no realistic mechanisms. Landscape dark petrol board. Show the same prop consistently in three-quarter, true overhead muzzle toward top of page, and side profile. Add a small solid black overhead silhouette and tiny illustrative overhead scale icon. Three-quarter is the large hero image on left, overhead on right, side below. White clean title and view labels. No real-world brands, no manufacturing details, no firing effects. Focus readable shape design with cartoon proportions. A short rounded shoulder stock, clear main grip and open front underside for support hand distinguish it from a little pistol or long rocket launcher. Color styling echoes a dark vibrant city with cyan/coral neon highlights and ordinary chunky architecture.

generationNotes: First A/B outputs rejected by image tool output safety checks (illicit category); C succeeded. One revised prompt pass used simpler toy-like fictional visual forms; A/B succeeded. Calls continued across owner-message interruptions; completed files recovered without repeat generation.
rights: No external models, textures, fonts or real brands requested. Original prompts by this workstream; generated references retain provenance here. No external asset license or legal exclusivity claim. Unexpected in-image slogans/decorative city graphics are unselected and will not be exported into the model.
